title: Prove exact dirty-output anchor child/ADD tariff frontier
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

PR1944 proves the one-common-call dirty-output echo boundary. This package extends it to exactly `r` common-product calls on `q` arbitrary-dirty output rows, for `1 <= r <= q`: the sharp minimum is **2(q-r) full-width ADDs**.

The model permits row-XOR ADDs, arbitrary gate ordering, feedback and independent private product calls; it admits no extra helper, COPY, CLEAR or free basis change. Under stationary complete prices, the bill is `q nu + r mu + 2(q-r)alpha`. Uniform tariffs favor the single-anchor or direct-call endpoint; positive destination-only tariffs admit an exact subset optimum, with a mixed-root example costing 4 versus 7 for direct calls and 23 for the best single root.

This is a written local-interface theorem with finite exact checks. A physical provider, source/frame/routing prices, selected placement, supplier admission and a new κ remain open.

## Task and overlap

Scope is **refined** from `complex-new-helper-inventory` to PR1944's open work-price question: whether adding dirty output anchors can improve the complete child-plus-ADD bill. Scientific base: `d8e0f83f00191df62174b641e9fff055c357f641`, priority revision 6.

Cinna Davis's [PR1944](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1944), pinned at `4e5159867eeb161995bdb3b51dfd184be1ce90cf`, supplies the one-call construction and bound. PR1968 addresses several different common terms, a separate obligation. [Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/3061).

Only `research/dirty-anchor-tradeoff/` is added.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -Werror -I -B scripts/research_package.py \
  --package research/dirty-anchor-tradeoff
```

The recorded local replay covers normal/optimized Python 3.12 and a separately implemented checker: 6,328 symbolic forward/inverse witnesses through q=112, 12,744 one-bit dirty-state assignments through q=5, complete affine searches through q=3, and all 819 independent small tariff cases. Seven mathematical controls, cross-version optimized replay and Git-free/receipt controls pass.

Finite checks support the written all-parameter proof; they do not supply its quantifier. No independent human or formal-kernel verification is claimed. Hosted CI is unverified at submission.

## Credit and next question

Credit Cinna Davis/PR1944 and its retained clean-helper, clean-output and source/native lineage. Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0.

[Proof, exact alphabet, source bindings and open next question](https://github.com/RossRichardson/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3f384b8b7daccb2c8e12013fd81a738202ce0f8d/research/dirty-anchor-tradeoff/README.md): identify one operand-compatible caller with legal target lifetimes and complete heterogeneous tariffs. Edge-dependent or changing frame prices require a replacement model before applying this optimizer.
